set nocompatible " cp:    turns off strict vi compatibility

" syntax on " enable syntax
" filetype plugin indent on " required!
colorscheme nofrils-dark
set background=dark

if has('gui_running')
  " gvim specific settings here
  set guifont=Monaco:h13
endif

" fix macvim crash
set guioptions-=e

" Time out on key codes but not mappings.
" Basically this makes terminal Vim work sanely.
if !has('gui_running')
  set notimeout
  set ttimeout
  set ttimeoutlen=10
  augroup FastEscape
    autocmd!
    au InsertEnter * set timeoutlen=0
    au InsertLeave * set timeoutlen=1000
  augroup END
endif

if has('mouse')
  set mouse=a
endif

set clipboard=unnamed,unnamedplus,autoselect
" if has('unnamed')
"   " set clipboard=unnamed
"   " set clipboard+=unnamedplus  " use the clipboards of vim and win
"   " set paste                   " Paste from a windows or from vim
"   " set go+=a                   " Visual selection automatically copied to the clipboard
" endif
if has('clipboard') && !has('gui_running')
  vnoremap <C-c> "+y
  vnoremap <C-x> "+d
  vnoremap <C-v> "+p
  inoremap <C-v> <C-r><C-o>+
endif

" copy and paste
" vmap <C-c> "+yi
" vmap <C-x> "+c
" vmap <C-v> c<ESC>"+p
" imap <C-v> <ESC>"+pa

if has('persistent_undo')
  set undofile
  set undodir=~/.cache/vim
endif

let mapleader = ","
" switch tabs
map { gT
map } gt

" ~/.viminfo needs to be writable and readable
" set viminfo='200
" set history=9999 " big history
" set lazyredraw          " Wait to redraw
" set cursorline
" set pumheight=20             " Completion window max size
" set hidden " load files in background
" set completeopt-=preview " disable scratch window
" set completeopt=menu,menuone
set enc=utf-8
set fileencoding=utf-8 " UTF-8
set tabstop=2       " number of visual spaces per TAB
set softtabstop=2   " number of spaces in tab when editing
set noerrorbells visualbell t_vb= " Disable ALL bells"
set autochdir
set showcmd             " show command in bottom bar
set wildmenu           " Autocomplete features in the status bar
set showmatch
set ruler
set nowrap           " do not automatically wrap on load
set formatoptions-=t " do not automatically wrap text when typing
set hlsearch         " highlight search
set ignorecase       " Do case in sensitive matching with
set smartcase        " be sensitive when there's a capital letter
set incsearch        " 
set textwidth=0      " Don't wrap lines by default
set shiftwidth=4
set shiftround
set backspace=indent,eol,start
set wildignore=*.o,*.obj,*.bak,*.exe,*.pyc,*.swp,*/tmp/*,*.so,*.swp,*.zip,*.tgz,*.tar.gz,*.iso
set completeopt=menu,menuone,noselect,noinsert
set complete=.,w,b,u,U,i,t " complete options
set confirm
set breakindent " this is just awesome (best patch in a long time)
set cmdheight=1 " Gets rid of all the press enter to continue
set nonumber " no line numbers
set shiftround " when at 3 spaces, and I hit > ... go to 4, not 5
set ttimeout " time out on key codes
set ttyfast " Assume a fast terminal
set omnifunc=syntaxcomplete#Complete
set infercase " case inferred by default
set diffopt=vertical,filler,iwhite " filler and whitespace
set linebreak " break on words not mid-word
set linespace=0 " don't insert any extra pixel lines betweens rows

nnoremap <Space> za " Spacebar to unfold

set nowritebackup
set nobackup
set directory=/tmp// " prepend(^=) $HOME/.tmp/ to default path; use full path as backup filename(//)

let g:terraform_align=1
let g:terraform_fmt_on_save=1
let g:ctrlp_max_height=40
let g:ctrlp_match_window='results:40'
" Ignore some folders and files for CtrlP indexing
let g:ctrlp_custom_ignore = {
  \ 'dir':  '\.git$\|\.yardoc\|public$|log\|tmp|\.hg|\.svn$',
  \ 'file': '\.so$\|\.dat$|\.DS_Store|\.pyc$'
  \ }

let NERDTreeShowHidden=1
nnoremap <leader>, :NERDTreeToggle<CR>
let NERDTreeIgnore = ['\~$','\.pyc$','\*NTUSER*','\*ntuser*','\NTUSER.DAT','\ntuser.ini']
let NERDTreeWinSize=80

command! -range -nargs=0 -bar JsonPretty <line1>,<line2>!jq --sort-keys '.'

if has("autocmd")
  autocmd BufNewFile,BufRead *.go setlocal noexpandtab tabstop=4 shiftwidth=4
  au filetype go inoremap <buffer> . .<C-x><C-o>
  autocmd BufNewFile,BufRead *.json set filetype=javascript
  autocmd BufRead,BufNewFile *.md set filetype=markdown
  autocmd FileType html,markdown setlocal omnifunc=htmlcomplete#CompleteTags
  autocmd FileType css setlocal omnifunc=csscomplete#CompleteCSS
  autocmd FileType bash set expandtab       " tabs are spaces
  autocmd FileType sh set expandtab       " tabs are spaces
  autocmd FileType ps1 set expandtab       " tabs are spaces
  autocmd FileType template set expandtab       " tabs are spaces
  autocmd FileType bzl set expandtab       " tabs are spaces
  autocmd FileType bazel set expandtab       " tabs are spaces
  autocmd FileType sh set expandtab       " tabs are spaces
  autocmd FileType html set expandtab       " tabs are spaces
  autocmd FileType yaml set expandtab       " tabs are spaces
  autocmd FileType json set expandtab       " tabs are spaces
  autocmd FileType tf set expandtab       " tabs are spaces
  autocmd FileType terraform set expandtab       " tabs are spaces
  autocmd FileType hcl set expandtab       " tabs are spaces
  autocmd FileType tmpl set expandtab       " tabs are spaces
  autocmd FileType javascript setlocal omnifunc=javascriptcomplete#CompleteJS
  autocmd FileType python set expandtab       " tabs are spaces
  autocmd FileType python set smartindent cinwords=if,elif,else,for,while,try,except,finally,def,class
  autocmd FileType python setlocal omnifunc=pythoncomplete#Complete
  autocmd Filetype python,java,javascript,go autocmd BufWritePre * :%s/\s\+$//e
  augroup spell_settings
    au!
    au BufEnter *.txt setlocal spell spelllang=en_us
    au BufEnter *.md  setlocal spell spelllang=en_us
    " to add multiple commands just append:
    " au BufEnter *.md  setlocal syntax
  augroup END
  augroup myvimrc
    au!
    au BufWritePost .vimrc,_vimrc,vimrc,.gvimrc,_gvimrc,gvimrc so $MYVIMRC | if has('gui_running') && filereadable($MYGVIMRC) | so $MYGVIMRC | endif
  augroup END
endif

set scrolloff=3        " keep at least 3 lines above/below"
if !&scrolloff
  set scrolloff=1
endif
if !&sidescrolloff
  set sidescrolloff=5
endif

" For conceal markers.
if has('conceal')
  set conceallevel=2 concealcursor=niv
endif
